results.content: # Graph Representation Learning | Beyond Transformers: Why Graph Neural Networks Are the Next Frontier in AI (July 2025) | Facebook. ## Graph Representation Learning ·. Beyond Transformers: Why Graph Neural Networks Are the Next Frontier in AI (July 2025). Take a look at the complex web of relationships in knowledge graphs, the neural networks in our brains, social media connections, molecular structure, and transportation networks. There is no meaningful method to arrange friends in a sequence that maintains the crucial relational information, so social networks lack a natural ordering. Similar to this, in drug discovery, the spatial arrangement of atoms and their bonds forms a three-dimensional graph structure that, when reduced to a sequence, loses important information. This is where the Graph Neural Networks shine. Instead of applying connected data into a straight line (like regular AI models do), GNNs work directly with the natural structure, where the dots (called nodes) for things like people or locations, and lines (called edges) that show how they’re connected.
